teaser: Hari Kota's ten-layer AI governance stack, kept as posted and turned into a fractal semantic graph: the gaps become missing edges, and queries.
core_idea: Keep Hari Kota's ten-layer stack exactly as posted as the view and make a fractal semantic graph the model: the table already contains ten edges across layers where rows share an instrument, role or jurisdiction; each layer is its own world with its own ontology, sharing only a grammar of verbs with inverses; the edges between worlds come from the provisions themselves, such as EU AI Act Article 26(2) and NIST AI RMF GOVERN 1.6; changes over time are dated edges rather than rewrites; and a gap is a missing edge, so the do-this-today test and the gaps in layers 3, 5 and 10 become queries anyone can run.

nodes.label: Hari's stack, as posted

nodes.label: Five grammar rules
nodes.summary: Verbs with inverses, no relates_to, data in properties, supersede never delete, render answers.

nodes.label: Edges from provisions

nodes.summary: System to owner, and system to classification to tier and basis; a missing step is the gap.
